facefix.title: Fix the face
facefix.needsImpact: Finding and redrawing faces needs the extension {pack}.
facefix.noDetector: The face detection model (YOLO) was not found. The Impact Subpack normally fetches it when it is installed, but that may have failed. Restart ComfyUI or install the extension again.
facefix.promptHint: The picture's own prompt is used. Adding the face's features helps.
facefix.strengthHint: Lower stays close to the original face, higher redraws it more.
facefix.sensitivityHint: Higher finds only sure faces; lower also finds small or turned faces but may pick up things that are not faces.
facefix.firstRun: The first run takes longer while the models load.
facefix.saved: Saved the picture with the faces fixed
facefix.done: The fixed picture was saved to the gallery.
